get_aur_packages.description: Read up to 100 AUR packages at once: version, description, votes and popularity, maintainers, whether and since when they are flagged out of date, when they were published and last changed, licences, keywords, dependencies and where to download their build files. Names the AUR doesn't have are listed separately.

description: Look up Arch Linux packages: search the official repositories and read a package's version, dependencies, maintainers and files; search the Arch User Repository (AUR) and read AUR packages' votes, maintainers and out-of-date flags; and check the security tracker for a package's open issues, issue groups, advisories and CVEs. A trigger starts a workflow when a package has a new version. No account or API key required. This integration is not affiliated with or endorsed by Arch Linux.

arch_linux_new_package_version_trigger.description: Runs when a package in Arch Linux's official repositories or the AUR has a new version, with the version before it, the repository, the package's description, maintainers and page. Official packages can also count versions reaching a testing repository.

parameters.name: package
